headline: Transfer rumors, news: Napoli eye moves for Zirkzee, Jackson
description: Manchester United forward Joshua Zirkzee and Chelsea's Nicolas Jackson are both linked with a move to Napoli. Transfer Talk has the latest.

headline: Man United's Marcus Rashford thanks Jamie Carragher for shutting down Gary Neville question
description: Marcus Rashford expressed his desire to focus on playing football without his "name being mentioned every day" in response to Gary Neville attempting to start a discussion about the Manchester United forward.

headline: Harry Kane: No longer have same 'itch' to return to England
description: Harry Kane said he no longer has the same "itch" to return to the Premier League as he did when he first left Tottenham Hotspur for Bayern Munich three years ago.

headline: USMNT, Coventry forward Haji Wright out with 'very serious' injury
description: United States forward Haji Wright has been ruled out for up to 12 weeks with a quad injury in a major blow to Coventry City for their return to the Premier League.

headline: Coventry boss Frank Lampard keen to emulate Sunderland, Leeds in Premier League return
description: Frank Lampard wants his Coventry City side to take inspiration from Sunderland and Leeds United as they prepare for a first Premier League campaign in 25 years.

headline: Summer transfer window: Grading big signings in men's soccer
description: The 2026 summer transfer window is open. Here is how we rated the biggest deals.
